Herein, an iron/β‐cyclodextrin (Fe(II)‐β‐CD) nanocomplex, synthesized at room temperature is characterized by various analytical techniques. The complex has a morphology of irregular‐particles with an average of 4–10 nm, and displays a porous structure. In vitro, the particles are well‐dispersible in the culture medium, which is typically an aqueous solution at pH = 7.4.
